cases.assertion: Decode bounded XLogData and primary keepalive framing.
Emit all write/flush/apply LSN fields from one durable complete-transaction boundary and answer requested replies without copying wal_end.
Decode Begin, Origin, Insert, Update, Delete, and Commit with row-only zero-based ordinals.
Require synchronous catalog admission for a new or changed Relation before following DML.
Reject null, absent, partial, or unchanged-TOAST canonical keys and unchanged TOAST anywhere in a key-changing update.
Admit only UPDATE of the fixed control identity and reject insert, delete, key change, and unexpected column mutation before feedback.
Reject Truncate application, streamed, two-phase, binary tuple, logical-message, type-message, and unknown protocol messages before feedback.
Reject truncated, oversized, overflowing, over-column, and over-tuple frames without panic or unbounded allocation.
Repeated identical Relation metadata and keepalives do not require a transaction or alter row ordinals.
The same golden corpus applies to explicitly admitted PostgreSQL 15, 16, and 17 protocol-v1 text output.
